status_note: First V3 iteration. Pure corpus scale-up test (n=75->100/schema/severity) under the now-deterministic V2 pipeline, no other changes. Negative result -- see logs/V3_TRAINING_FAILURES.md V3 Iteration 1 for full analysis and the mechanistic hypothesis (total training steps, not corpus size per se) this result points to.

provenance.note: Launched before the fuzzy-support gate fix (commit 542a3cc) was ready -- this run used the strict (non-fuzzy) gate, same as iteration 15.
provenance.orchestrator: manual (src/01_generate_teacher.py, src/02_train_distill.py, src/08_hybrid_eval.py, src/07_failure_eval.py via SSH + nohup)
provenance.checkpoint_backup_performed_manually: models/distilled_minicpm5_1b_v2_amd_V2_FINAL_iter15 (V2's final checkpoint, iteration 15, preserved/labeled before this V3 run started)

training_configuration.changes_from_iteration_15: NONE except the training corpus -- same seed (42), LR (2e-5), 3 epochs, batch_size 2, AdamW, cosine schedule, bf16.
training_configuration.total_training_steps_comparison: 3237 (1079 steps/epoch x 3) vs. iteration 15's 2439 (813 x 3) -- 33% more gradient updates from the larger admitted-example count, same epoch count.

per_epoch_loss.note: identical final loss (0.0052) to iteration 15 despite 33% more training steps and more data -- both runs converge to the same near-zero-loss plateau.

evaluation_metrics_72record_eval.comparison_to_iteration_15: field F1 DROPPED (0.6827 -> 0.6581, -0.0246) despite MORE admitted training examples (1625 -> 2157) under an otherwise identical, now-deterministic pipeline. This is the cleanest evidence yet that scaling corpus size past ~1600 admitted examples does not help and may actively hurt under this project's fixed 3-epoch training schedule -- see logs/V3_TRAINING_FAILURES.md for the total-training-steps hypothesis this points to.

final_artifacts.checkpoint_used_for_huggingface_upload_n: Worse than the published V2 (iteration 15) checkpoint on every headline metric. Not a candidate.
